name: VS Code Copilot Chat agent mode

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The Chat Debug view shows the raw system prompt, user prompt, context, and tool payloads for each interaction.
system_prompt_style.evidence_locator: doc "Use chat in VS Code", Troubleshoot chat interactions
system_prompt_style.note: Custom instructions and custom agents shape the prompt; mechanism not shown in code.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Implicit context: VS Code automatically includes the active file, your current selection, and the file name as context. When you use agents, the agent decides autonomously if additional context is needed.
env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: doc, Add context to your prompts

observation_format.evidence_quote: Media files from tool results (such as the integrated browser, Playwright, or other MCP servers) and inlined in assistant messages are all accessible from the carousel.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Extend with tools: connect MCP servers or install extensions that contribute tools to give the agent access to external services, databases, or APIs.
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schema source not described.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: connect MCP servers or install extensions that contribute tools

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent can answer questions, analyze your code, run tools, make changes, and respond with a summary.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: You can run multiple sessions in parallel and switch between them without losing context.
multi_agent_topology.note: Parallel sessions are separate conversations, not multi-agent topology.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: to configure when you receive an OS notification when the agent needs your input or confirmation to continue.
human_in_loop.evidence_locator: doc, Get notified about chat responses
human_in_loop.note: Sessions have a configurable permission level.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: You can run multiple sessions in parallel and switch between them without losing context.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: tailor the AI's behavior to your project by adding custom instructions, creating reusable prompt files, or building custom agents for specialized workflows
long_term_memory.note: Instruction/prompt files persist across runs; not true learned memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: To restore affected workspace files and chat history, restore a checkpoint.
state_persistence.evidence_locator: doc, Send messages while a request is running

rollback.evidence_quote: To restore affected workspace files and chat history, restore a checkpoint. Checkpoints don't reverse changes to external services.
rollback.evidence_locator: doc, Send messages while a request is running

termination_condition.evidence_quote: run tools, make changes, and respond with a summary. You can then continue the conversation with follow-up messages.
termination_condition.note: User can also cancel: Stop and Send.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Each session has configuration options that shape how the agent responds, such as the agent harness, agent role, permission level, and language model.
cost_controls.note: User-selected model, not automatic cost routing.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The command runs immediately in the session's default shell, without sending the message to the agent or asking for approval. It uses the session folder or worktree as the working directory.
execution_isolation.evidence_locator: doc, Run terminal commands from chat

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: It uses the session folder or worktree as the working directory.
filesystem_access.evidence_locator: doc, Run terminal commands from chat
filesystem_access.note: Local shell on host; no path restriction described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: connect MCP servers or install extensions that contribute tools to give the agent access to external services, databases, or APIs

permission_model.evidence_quote: to configure when you receive an OS notification when the agent needs your input or confirmation to continue.
permission_model.evidence_locator: doc, Get notified about chat responses
permission_model.note: Permission level is a per-session configuration option.

tracing.evidence_quote: Agent Logs shows a chronological event log of tool calls, LLM requests, and prompt file discovery.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Each session has configuration options that shape how the agent responds, such as the agent harness, agent role, permission level, and language model.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Ask questions about your code, get help understanding complex logic, generate new features, fix bugs, and more, all through a conversational interface.
target_domain.note: Browser elements and MCP support give web/general tool use.

open_source.evidence_quote: Support for GitHub Copilot Chat is provided by GitHub and can be reached at https://support.github.com.

model_agnostic.note: Language model is selectable per session but providers are not listed.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This article describes interaction mechanics shared by chat surfaces in VS Code
primary_artifact.note: Coded from product documentation (grey literature), not a paper.
